def command(*arguments):
    return subprocess.check_output(arguments, text=True).strip()


def green_guard():
    current = json.loads(command('gh', 'pr', 'view', '4093', '--repo', REPO, '--json', 'headRefOid,statusCheckRollup,headRefName,body'))
    assert current['headRefOid'] == SOURCE
    checks = current['statusCheckRollup']
    assert len(checks) >= 8 and all(check['status'] == 'COMPLETED' and check['conclusion'] == 'SUCCESS' for check in checks)
    workflows = json.loads(command('gh', 'run', 'list', '--repo', REPO, '--branch', current['headRefName'], '--limit', '100', '--json', 'databaseId,headSha,workflowName,status,conclusion'))
    relevant = [run for run in workflows if run['headSha'] == SOURCE]
    assert relevant and all(run['status'] == 'completed' and run['conclusion'] == 'success' for run in relevant)
    assert current['body'] == (ROOT / 'pr-body-checkpoint-25-results.txt').read_text()
    remote = command('git', 'ls-remote', 'origin', 'refs/heads/' + current['headRefName']).split()[0]
    assert remote == SOURCE
    return {'head': SOURCE, 'checks': checks, 'runs': relevant, 'remote': remote}


assert command('git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD') == SOURCE
branch = command('git', 'branch', '--show-current')
assert branch == 'agent/mbp-m5-max-128/codex-conquest-1016/conquest-campaign-capacity-20261017T172623Z-ecd1'
assert not command('git', 'diff', '--name-only', SOURCE, '--', 'src', 'Cargo.toml', 'Cargo.lock')
assert not command('git', 'diff', '--cached', '--name-only')
analysis = json.loads((ROOT / 'variant-25/development-analysis.json').read_text())

assert all(run['status'] == 'completed' and run['conclusion'] == 'success' for run in metadata['new_metadata_runs'])
filenames = [PREFIX + suffix for suffix in ['.progress.json', '.checkpoint-25.delta.provenance.json.gz', '.checkpoint-25.parent-comparison.json']]
progress = json.loads(Path(filenames[0]).read_text())
assert progress['execution_counts']['development_executions'] == 150
assert progress['execution_counts']['completed_resource_diagnostic_executions'] == 90
receipt = json.loads((ROOT / 'archive-checkpoint-25-verification.json').read_text())

content = Path(receipt['archive']).read_bytes()

supplement = progress['variant_25_parent_comparison_supplement']

assert sorted(command('git', 'diff', '--cached', '--name-only').splitlines()) == sorted(filenames)
subprocess.run(['git', 'diff', '--cached', '--check'], check=True)
subprocess.run(['git', 'commit', '-m', 'Archive funded noncapital science and complete fixed-map evidence', '-m', 'Computer: MacBook Pro'], check=True)
head = command('git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD')
assert not command('git', 'diff', '--name-only', SOURCE, head, '--', 'src', 'Cargo.toml', 'Cargo.lock')
assert not command('git', 'status', '--porcelain')

import ast
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent


def create(name, content):
    filename = ROOT / name
    assert not filename.exists()
    if filename.suffix == '.py':
        ast.parse(content)
    operation = '*** Add File: ' + str(filename) + '\n' + ''.join('+' + line + '\n' for line in content.splitlines())
    subprocess.run(['apply_patch'], input='*** Begin Patch\n' + operation + '*** End Patch\n', text=True, check=True, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL)
